AccountRecord.title: AccountRecord
AccountRecord.description: Authorized Google account record mapping an email key to a role (admin or user) for RBAC.

email.description: Lowercased Google email address of the authorized account.

displayName.description: Display name shown in the dashboard.

role.description: Access role determining permissions across personnel and roster menus.

roleLabel.description: Operational role or unit title shown in the UI.

active.description: Whether the account is currently enabled.

createdByUid.description: UID of the admin who created this account record.

updatedByUid.description: UID of the admin who last updated this account record.

AccountDirectory.title: AccountDirectory
AccountDirectory.description: Admin-only directory summary listing all registered Admin and User accounts.

items.description: Array of registered account summary objects.

createdByUid.description: UID of the admin who initialized the directory.

updatedByUid.description: UID of the admin who last updated the directory.

RosterConfig.title: RosterConfig
RosterConfig.description: Shared organizational header, personnel list, unit ordering, and PAWAS anchor configuration. Admin-write, member-read.

header.description: Institutional header lines and signer metadata.

pawasAnchor.description: PAWAS rotation anchor date and personnelId.

lastBackupAt.description: ISO timestamp of last manual backup export.

createdByUid.description: UID of the admin who created the roster config.

updatedByUid.description: UID of the admin who last updated the roster config.

RosterOverridesDoc.title: RosterOverridesDoc
RosterOverridesDoc.description: Shared manual shift overrides map for the duty roster. Admin-write, member-read.

overrides.description: Map of personnelId__YYYY-MM-DD keys to shift codes.

createdByUid.description: UID of the admin who created the overrides document.

updatedByUid.description: UID of the admin who last updated the overrides document.

RengiatStateDoc.title: RengiatStateDoc
RengiatStateDoc.description: Shared daily activity plans (Rengiat) state accessible to both Admin and User.

unitLabel.description: Unit display name for Rengiat reports.

selectedWaDates.description: Selected date keys included in WhatsApp export.

createdByUid.description: UID of the member who created the document.

updatedByUid.description: UID of the member who last updated the document.

PamStateDoc.title: PamStateDoc
PamStateDoc.description: Shared PAM AKSI and PAM GIAT roster drafts and saved lists accessible to both Admin and User.

drafts.description: Draft objects for AKSI and GIAT.

createdByUid.description: UID of the member who created the document.

updatedByUid.description: UID of the member who last updated the document.

SuratStateDoc.title: SuratStateDoc
SuratStateDoc.description: Shared Surat Perintah and Surat Biasa drafts and saved documents accessible to both Admin and User.

/accounts/{accountId}.description: Individual RBAC account records keyed by sanitized email slug. Readable only by owner (get) or Admin.

/workspace_admin/account_directory.description: Admin-only directory of all registered Admin and User accounts.

/workspace/roster_overrides.description: Shared manual shift overrides for the duty roster. Writable only by Admin.

/workspace/rengiat_state.description: Shared Rengiat state readable and writable by registered Admin and User accounts.

/workspace/pam_state.description: Shared Daftar Pers PAM state readable and writable by registered Admin and User accounts.
